response.justification: While the candidate has extensive software development experience across multiple languages and domains, there is no evidence of professional C++ development on Windows or direct experience in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking — all mandatory requirements. His C++ exposure is limited to academic/bachelor’s thesis work and outdated NI LabWindows roles, insufficient for a mid-senior role in this specialized domain.
strengths: Strong full-stack experience with modern languages and DevOps practices
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex systems across domains
Active contributor to open-source tools and community education
concerns: No professional C++ on Windows platform as required
Lacks any demonstrated fixed income, capital markets, or banking domain experience
SQL experience listed but not contextualized in financial systems or high-volume trading environments
